前半句和后半句逐字打入。中间槽位先留空，再把翻转词按 snapcn 的 ease: Type the first half of the sentence and the second half of the sentence verbatim. Leave the middle slot empty first, and then press snapcn's easeInBack to flip the flipped word in three-dimensionally, so that the line width will not be squeezed. There is no icon by default; when clicking on the icon, first click on the column to be inserted.
